name: vscode-chatgpt-linter
description: Lints code via ChatGPT according to your custom rules, and shows inline squiggles in VS Code editor, like eslint does.

scripts.package: rm -f vscode-chatgpt-linter*.vsix && npm run build && vsce package && unzip -l vscode-chatgpt-linter*.vsix
scripts.package:publish: npm run package && echo 'Publishing in 5s...' && sleep 5 && vsce publish
scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.cjs && cp ./src/typechatSchema.ts ./dist/
scripts.build: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.cjs --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint

author: Yu Li

chatgptLinter.apiKeyForOpenAi.title: API key for OpenAI
chatgptLinter.apiKeyForOpenAi.description: Your OpenAI API key for ChatGPT requests
chatgptLinter.apiKeyForOpenAi.markdownDescription: Your [OpenAI API key](https://auth.openai.com/log-in) for ChatGPT requests.

chatgptLinter.stylePath.description: Path to your style guide file relative to the workspace root.

chatgptLinter.lintFileName.description: Output file name for ChatGPT lint results (relative to workspace root).
